description: This file defines the SlugifyParameterTransformer class which implements the IOutboundParameterTransformer interface from ASP.NET Core. The class provides a method to transform strings into a 'slug' format suitable for URLs by inserting hyphens and converting to lowercase.

classes.name: SlugifyParameterTransformer
classes.description: A class that transforms string parameters into a URL-friendly slug format by inserting hyphens before uppercase letters and converting to lowercase, implementing the IOutboundParameterTransformer interface.

methods.name: TransformOutbound
methods.description: Transforms an input object into a slug string suitable for URL usage by inserting hyphens before uppercase letters in the string and converting it to lowercase.
